rule: A sessionless request follows the switch without creating a session merely to decide.
Anonymous/sessionless requests may proxy without manufacturing affinity.
A session created before enablement remains legacy until it ends.
A session created before disablement remains modern until it ends.
A recorded modern decision can never be treated as undecided.
An established modern session never falls back to legacy.
Destroy both runtime sessions and decide again on the next request that needs a session.
Remove context-local decision and affinity after both runtime caches return to baseline.
Container-side destruction cannot leave a reusable decision or affinity.
Restore the pristine legacy WAR and invalidate, never convert, live modern sessions.
No context may read or mutate another context's session or affinity.
